question: What textual section concludes with this colophon statement?
premises: The statement marks an ending with iti.
It names the Meru Tantra composed by Shiva.
It identifies the thirty-first chapter on Shiva-mantra teaching.
inference: This is the colophon of the thirty-first chapter of the Meru Tantra.
plain_english: Thus ends the thirty-first chapter, named the teaching of Shiva mantras, in the Meru Tantra composed by Shiva with the approval of glorious Maha Maya and Maha Kala.
